topic: Local SEO Quick Win: Get on Google Maps in 48 Hours
title: Get on Google Maps in 48 Hours (Local SEO Quick Win)
title_options: Claim Your Spot on Google Maps Fast
Local SEO Quick Win: Maps in 2 Days
description:
One simple, low-cost tactic to get your business visible on Google Maps fast. Follow this step-by-step example you can copy today.
You don't need an agency. This short shows the exact action, words to use, and realistic time expectations for a bakery, plumber, or salon.

scenes.narration: Want on Google Maps in 48 hours?
scenes.doodle_prompt: map pin on storefront, small person pointing

scenes.narration: One tip: claim your Google Business Profile and verify it. That single step can get you on Maps quickly.
scenes.visual_query: person typing on laptop at kitchen table

scenes.narration: Example: a bakery. Use business name, address, category 'Bakery', phone, hours, and upload one clean photo of your storefront.
scenes.doodle_prompt: small bakery storefront, baker holding a loaf

scenes.narration: Step-by-step: open Google Business Profile, click 'Add your business', fill details, choose verification by postcard or phone, then submit.
Cost: free. Time: 10–30 minutes to set up, verification often completes in 48 hours. Have one clear storefront photo ready.
scenes.visual_query: camera taking photo of shop exterior
scenes.doodle_prompt: camera pointing at a small shop exterior, sun overhead

scenes.narration: Do this now: claim the profile, add details, verify. Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
scenes.visual_query: small business owner smiling outside shop
